# Papercusp documentation corpus: source-identified counts and 50-entry sample — 2026-11-15

Original P-011 · language-neutral-code-documentation-integration-2026-11-12 · WI-6554700010047696

Three sampled entries contain a confirmed source contradiction, including one of four sampled fresh-badged documents. The named materialization contains 35,037 text/source file envelopes across 40 first-party repositories. The 50-entry class-balanced sample covers all 15 nonempty eligible declared classes. This is the count/sample report required before the P-016 constructor; independent report proof and acceptance are still open.

## What the sample establishes

Every selected id has a disposition: **21 source-consistent selected claims, 3 contradicted entries, 12 explicitly historical entries, 6 without an applicable documentation claim, and 8 unresolved entries**. “Consistent” means the named claim agrees with the code read; it does not certify every assertion in a long document. “Contradicted” means at least one concrete current-source conflict was found. Historical measurements remain historical.

The confirmed stale-entry lower bound is **3/50 (6%) of the selected entries**. Among the **24 entries with an assessed selected current-source claim**, the contradiction rate is **3/24 (12.5%)**. These are sample measurements, not an estimate that 6% or 12.5% of the entire corpus is stale. Equal class allocation, mixed unit sizes, historical material and unresolved entries preclude that extrapolation.

The fresh-badged class has 4 sampled entries: 2 source-consistent claims, 1 contradiction, 1 unresolved. Its measured stale lower bound is **1/4 (25%) of this sample**, not a population rate. The badge was recorded separately from semantic judgment.

## Source vector and scope

Registry capture: `2026-11-15T14:24:46.561351+00:00`; PostgreSQL named materialization snapshot `1185430322:1185474073:1185430322,1185473720,1185474021,1185474029,1185474060`; database `papercusp`; workspace `papercusp-workspace`; harness `papercusp`.

File-manifest SHA-256: `2223e9e6e3bbda320417d134d4bee3294a8c8ccba4f9ad5aa40f2eec063052de`. Candidate-entry-manifest SHA-256: `59a74a0acd92b7a865d8b4fde3fb1a6303c4ab41e03b35a2dc5fbb69f7a1aff8`. Instrument: `p011-measurement-v2`; TypeScript compiler scanner `6.0.3`. Provider read errors: `0`.

The registry provider reads harness_docs, harness_doc_parts, harness-scoped code-note facts, harness_prompt_overrides, blueprint projection metadata and saved prompts. The repository provider reuses the maintained git ls-files boundary: tracked files plus nonignored untracked files in the superproject and all 39 declared first-party submodules. Origins, actual working HEADs and tree ids are retained below; no branch switch, commit, migration or product write was performed. Per-file SHA-256 covers the working bytes, including untracked bytes.

These are representation/candidate counts at their natural grains. A document parent, its prose parts, a generated copy, a source-file envelope and comments inside a file are different representations. Their sum is **not** a count of unique logical documents. Canonical registry file projections are aliases; 1,099 paired HTML/Markdown delivered twins are recorded as aliases rather than counted a second time as documentation entries.

Authored and composed language counts resolve anchor_paths and subject_ref.globs against actual source paths in the named file manifest. Composed parts inherit the composed parent’s recorded anchors. Native TypeScript-family counts are compiler-scanned /** comment candidates (including JS-family files); Rust counts are contiguous /// or //! lexical groups. These are candidate-existence counts, not certified declaration associations, complete Rust block-comment counts or an approved pilot selection.

Both composed strata have zero metadata-linked candidates. This does **not** prove composed prose never mentions these languages. P-009/P-012 must preserve both zero/unresolved fields. They cannot fabricate bindings, silently omit a required stratum, claim an owner exception or replace the prior independent pilot-selection approval. Genuine eligible source associations or a target-specific explicit owner scope decision are required before that pilot can proceed.

## Deterministic sampling procedure

Seed: `papercusp:P-011:2026-11-15:class-balanced:v1`.

Within each class, filter eligible entries, compute SHA-256(seed + NUL + stable scoped id), and sort by that digest. Visit classes in sorted class-name order, taking one next ranked entry per class per round until 50 entries are selected, or all eligible entries if fewer. This allocates at least one sample to every nonempty eligible class. Here 15 such classes require 15 minimum slots, below the target of 50; the final allocation is in the table. No manual replacement was made after semantic review.

Ordered sample identity SHA-256: `e32317379ad91c5c50eca383cd34937f80a3c1792e7fbc4cacf5e439b12ab26a`. The saved sample contains exactly 50 distinct ids. All 13 separately fetched registry sample bodies matched the captured body MD5. All sampled file SHA-256 values still matched at the validation read, and all 6 native selected byte ranges exactly reproduced the saved comment bytes.

The measurement artifact records source bytes, field-level metadata, each sampled id, explicit judgment scope, evidence file hashes and unresolved limits. Its self-recount reconciles all 114,937 distinct mixed-grain measurement ids, class totals, eligibility and sample slots; it is **not** the required outside-lineage recount/acceptance receipt.

## Confirmed contradictions and correction ownership

Corrections are filed and assigned to this session in **WI-6554700010049486**. No correction is claimed complete.

1. `doc:agent-insights/git-sync-turn-scoped-commit-hold.mdx`: the prose describes the 60-minute cap per edit and says never-journaling editors remain held until the cap or session end. Current `packages/operator-core/lib/personal-vault/git-sync-hold.ts::readTurnHoldings` uses the turn’s oldest edit for a whole-turn cap and requires a journaled turn; never-journaling editors are excluded. The current code’s SQL and explanatory contract agree.
2. `doc:agent-insights/reading-the-loop-routed-triage-corpus.mdx` (**fresh**): its blanket claim that no read-side surface identifies origin before a write is contradicted by the canonical `work_items:get` read of P-011, which returned `workItem.origin: local` before claim. Historical August census measurements are not being retracted.
3. `file:apps/operator/public/internal/docs/endpoint-system/gating.md`: the page identifies its order as DEFAULT_DISPATCH_STACK but omits `kernel-preflight`. Current `libs/generic/tooldef/src/dispatch-stack.ts` places kernelPreflightStep first. The canonical source page also omits the kernel description. The same follow-up records a nearby stale native “Runs first” default-deny comment and the unresolved social guide’s missing platform-registry anchor.

The observed detector gap is semantic drift: retained anchors or a freshness badge did not establish that these particular assertions still matched the writer. The follow-up requires canonical docs:author corrections, source/mirror verification and a recurrence guard in the maintained test framework.

## Limits and pending acceptance

- This is a named multi-provider materialization, not a globally atomic frozen edition. The registry snapshot is retained as data; file identities are per-read working hashes. Repository heads can move during a shared-tree scan. Sample bytes and metadata were checked explicitly, but a whole-source-vector pre/post stability proof has not been established. P-016 owns coherent freeze/restart/reconciliation.
- The file provider’s declared extensions are retained in measure.py. Other extensions (6,880 file entries), ignored first-party material and delivered home-directory launch-context projections outside the repository roots are not semantically measured here. Build/vendor/VCS/scratch rules exclude 1,315 text candidates; 39 directory/symlink entries are excluded. Those bounds are provider scope, not claims of complete all-format/all-location coverage.
- /** scanner candidates are not complete parser-certified commentary; Rust /// and //! grouping omits block doc-comment forms. Unsupported sources remain file/container envelopes. Tests, examples, archives and dated reports remain visible and are not relabeled as current operational truth.
- Per-class allocation is deliberately balanced, not proportional; classes with one eligible entry are exhausted. A short comment and a 91k-character composed parent have different judgment costs. Eight unresolved entries remain explicit; 21 consistent results cover named claims, not full-document certification.
- No live phone, social publication, Slack send, hosted transport, UI journey or deployment was attempted for this count/sample. The selected operator-api route was measured as staging-operator :3170, build d4b5ee03da7 containing reports/publish.ts; the corpus source is the canonical staging working tree and the shared scoped registry. This is not release-operator shipment evidence.
- P-011 remains open for canonical independent report-native recount/judgment review, altered-count, inverted-judgment, missing-identity/limits, omitted-nonempty-class and missing-stratum-field controls, maintained run/case reconciliation, and formal R-15 evidence binding/grading. P-016’s constructor proof cannot substitute for this report contribution. No corpus import, pilot selection, validator qualification or shipment is certified.

## Owner checkpoint and next work

D-018 reserves the class-scope checkpoint to Avi after this result. The explicit classes and unresolved strata above are the decision input. Historical/fixture/projection representations require applicability and alias rules, not silent deletion from the denominator. The selected SELF/AUTO route continues for the mechanism; any remaining owner choice about follow-on scope/route must be resolved from actual owner authority. P-016 can now be sized from the measured grains; the remaining P-017 proof implementation is retained and mandatory. Full-corpus clean-up and independent acceptance remain in the follow-on plan, not dropped.
